title: Bassist Van Son Lashley
summary: Lawrence says Lashley was a good reading bass player who played in the society brass band.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Is Van Son Lashley dead or not?
Yeah, he's dead. He was a good bass player.
Do you know how to spell his name?

SHR NE I think that's the way he was. He was a good reader. He played with our brass band with us too. Our band, you see, we'd make up a brass band for the society, for the band, we wanted to have a parade. He played bass for us. Several times.
